title: The Maharashtra Animal and Fishery Sciences University Act, 1998.
full_text: The Maharashtra Animal and Fishery Sciences University Act, 1998. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 199817 Act Number: 17 Enactment Date: 1998-05-04 Act Year: 1998 Short Title: The Maharashtra Animal and Fishery Sciences University Act, 1998. Long Title: An Act to provide for the establishment and incorporation of the Animal and Fishery Sciences University in the State of Maharashtra and for matters connected therewith and incidental thereto. Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Agriculture, Animal Husbandry, Dairy Development and Fisheries Department Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra Schedule 1.
